description: VN 'theo tôi / theo ý kiến của tôi' transfer: learners write 'according to me / according to my opinion' where idiomatic English uses 'in my opinion'. Rule en-vietlish-discourse-according-to-me rewrites only the first-person object, preserving leading capitalization, and abstains on every external-source 'according to' (the report / him / scientists) and on coordinator tails.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. 'according to' is correct and common for citing external sources; only the first-person 'me / my opinion' object is the Vietlish tell. Negatives lock external-source objects (the report / him / scientists) and the coordinator tail 'according to me and my team'.

positive.input: According to me, English is hard.
positive.expectedCorrection: In my opinion, English is hard.
positive.notes: Sentence-initial 'According to me,' -> 'In my opinion,' with capitalization preserved.

positive.input: According to my opinion, we should wait.
positive.expectedCorrection: In my opinion, we should wait.
positive.notes: 'according to my opinion' is doubly redundant -> 'in my opinion'.

positive.input: The plan is good according to me.
positive.expectedCorrection: The plan is good in my opinion.

negative.input: According to the report, sales rose.
negative.expectedCorrection: According to the report, sales rose.
negative.notes: External source 'the report' is correct -> must abstain.

negative.input: According to him, the bus is late.
negative.expectedCorrection: According to him, the bus is late.
negative.notes: Third-person source is correct -> must abstain.

negative.input: According to scientists, the earth is warming.
negative.expectedCorrection: According to scientists, the earth is warming.
negative.notes: Authority source is correct -> must abstain.

negative.input: According to me and my team, it works.
negative.expectedCorrection: According to me and my team, it works.
negative.notes: Coordinator 'and' after 'me' means a compound source; 'in my opinion and my team' would be ungrammatical -> must abstain.
